content.comment_body: Hello, I hope everyone is doing well. Based on the statement, "I am confident that my configuration is correct because I can connect to the web server from anywhere without any issues. It appears the problem is only with [product_name] Comfort." Were you able to monitor or modify the internal variables of the [product_name] remotely? If so, could you explain how to set up DDNS for remote communication with the [product_name]? I appreciate any guidance provided and look forward to your response. Best of luck.
Hello [user_name], Please avoid posting multiple times about the same issue. You also asked about DynDNS in your other thread: Access [product_name] Web Server Remotely.

This topic has been closed because the question was posted more than once. The second thread titled 'Access [product_name] Web Server Remotely' is available within the [product_name] - Communication conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation centers around the user's difficulties in establishing remote communication with a [company_name] [product_name] device using DDNS. Specifically, the user can access the web server remotely but encounters problems when trying to do the same with [product_name] Comfort software. Guidance is sought for setting up DDNS to achieve remote monitoring or modification of internal variables. Discussions indicate a lack of clear instructions for remote DDNS configuration and highlight inconsistencies between software and web server access.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects detailed, easy-to-follow instructions for configuring remote access to the [product_name] using DDNS—similar to their success with accessing the web server. They want to use the [product_name] Comfort tool for remote monitoring and control, seeking clarity and stepwise guidance.
